description: Modified-sandwich SettingsModel checkpoint: the six Theme contracts now have direct safe Rust ownership and Microsoft-derived witnesses.

entries.notes: The Rust Theme owner parses the theme name, RGBA/RGB tab-row colors, light application theme and useMica=true with the same observable values as Microsoft.
A name-only theme preserves null TabRow/Window owners and reports the default/system requested theme.
A theme with tabRow but no window preserves its RGB color and falls back to ElementTheme::Default.
An explicit window:null is treated as no window while the tab-row object remains materialized, matching Theme::FromJson.
The Rust collection distinguishes tabRow:{} and tabRow.background:null from an omitted tabRow without default-constructing a ThemeColor.
An unknown requested theme emits UnknownTheme while preserving parsed custom themes and selecting the built-in system fallback.
